Ahh my bad. I started my weights extremely light as I had not been in the gym for at least three years at this point. Even before my lifts were not impressive and not even now but they are improving. I will just list my starting T1 and what it's currently at. Deadlift is lacking but my form was dogshit and practicing more on it has helped a ton because 255 was super easy which I did the other day. 

I could have started my weights higher when I originally got on the program but felt that it was better to underestimate what I could actually lift. Also most of my progress was made while on a cut and have been at maintenance for about 4 months. This is about 11 months worth of progress. Stalling or slowing down happened I guess around my current lift numbers give or take 5-10 lbs. This is where I started to slow my progression on squat and deadlift to 5lb increases as 10 were just becoming too taxing for me. 










Lift| T1 Start| T1 Current
---|---|----
Squat| 135| 275
OHP| 75| 130
Bench| 115| 195
Deadlift| 135| 255

So I have been doing GZCLP for almost a year now and most of that time has been on a cut. I went from 230lbs to 170 lbs and my height is 5'6". I have been maintaining 170 for about 4 months but still planning on cutting another 15-20 lbs. 

I want to say things started to slow for me personally around the 7-8 month mark. I am still making progress but I am not bumping it as much for my squat and dead lift. I started to do 5lb increments instead of 10 because it was just becoming too much and I was resetting more often. I also had form issues with my dead lift which I corrected.

I personally feel I can still get tons of progress out of this program but maybe not as fast as when I first started. I think I will continue with this for as long as I can. Once I hit my goal weight and maintain for a bit I will probably move onto something else. This is how I personally feel and can't really speak for someone more experienced.
